note: North Dakota's 14th state park, opened in 2026 six miles west of Walhalla on the rim of the Pembina Gorge: open, sunny gravel pull-through pads built long for OHV trailers, with designated trailer parking; premium sites add sewer. The park system's only OHV campground, with 16+ miles of multi-use trails a few miles away. Friday and Saturday nights cost $5 more. The primitive sites are 10-ft tent pads. --Claude
summary: Agency page and reserveNDparks read: 44 modern/premium pull-through gravel pads (78-97 ft) in Rendezvous Loop plus 2 premium in Trappers Hollow, 50/30/20 A and water at every RV site, sewer at premium, 2 group sites, 5 primitive tent pads; $25/$30 weekdays, +$5 Fri/Sat. Hookups/sites written. Pin is ~3.9 km off on farmland - move to the campground. Season conflict: the manual year_round is contradicted by the grid (all sites blocked from Dec 1; only 3 premium sites open in late November). Not waterfront stands. OHV campground flagged (caveat, not drop).
flags: PIN: stored 48.95648,-98.06018 is a field edge 3.9 km north-northwest with no campground (the note's 'Pin is the reservation portal's'). Imagery at Google's 48.92259,-98.04451 shows the new campground: two gravel loops of angled pull-through pads. Move to ~48.9230,-98.0448 (loop centre); re-pin elevation_meters with it. The note's 'satellite imagery predates the campground' is no longer true (Esri now shows it under construction).

SEASON (manual group, not overwritten): stored year_round true rests on the department-wide limited-service page. Pembina's own reservation grid shows every site blocked from 2026-12-01 through the end of the window (2027-02-14), with only Premium #17-#19 free in late November. Reviewer: year_round false, or keep year-round with 'Three premium sites stay open into late November; all sites are closed to booking December through mid-February.'

FEES (manual group, not overwritten): range 25-35 matches the agency page; the stored fees.note 'Modern sites; new campground opened 2026.' is stale - suggest 'Modern sites $25, premium (sewer) $30; +$5 Friday and Saturday.' The Friday/Saturday +$5 is in the new note meanwhile. Primitive $15 sites are 10-ft tent pads (IsTentSite true, IsRVSite false), so the base stays $25.

CRITERIA (OHV): 'the only OHV campground in the state park system' with 'designated trailer parking areas'; the multi-use trail system starts 'a few miles from the campground', so it is an OHV-friendly general campground, not a trailhead staging lot - caveat, not a drop.

INCLUSION: drive-in, gravel level pull-throughs 78-97 ft long and 20 ft wide; a 23-ft rig fits. The agency says nothing about a road problem. Pad lengths vary site by site with surveyed attributes (distance to comfort station, shade), unlike the placeholder lengths seen elsewhere on reserveNDparks.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands - the pads sit on the upland rim above the wooded gorge; the Pembina River is ~300+ m south behind continuous woods.
PHONE: 701-549-2444 confirmed (park page). WEBSITE: https://www.parkrec.nd.gov/pembina-gorge-state-park and https://www.reservendparks.com/Web/#!park/62 confirmed.
